name: Ronde van Nederland deel 4 - Krijtlandpad
description_md:
Ronde van Nederland deel 4 - Krijtlandpad is a waymarked hiking route covering 68.8 km. This hard route features 1374 m of ascent and 1327 m of descent.

The route takes about 21 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It is part of the international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as RvN in the Netherlands. Nearby places include Helpoort within 300 m, Sint-Matthiaskerk within 600 m, and Schneeberg within 1400 m.
